label: Applying directly to a French-speaking Belgian institution for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Apply on the institution's own website
milestones.note: Wallonie-Bruxelles Campus recommends applying between February and 31 March. Each institution's own date is the binding one.

milestones.label: Register for the ARES medicine, dentistry and veterinary entrance exam
milestones.note: In 2026 registration ran 18 May to 5 July, 23:59.

milestones.label: ARES entrance exam (concours)
milestones.note: One sitting a year, in late August. In 2026 it was 27 August, with results on 4 September.

submissionItems.label: No diploma equivalence needed for a full IB Diploma
submissionItems.note: Other foreign diplomas need an equivalence by 15 July. An IB Diploma from an IB-recognised school does not.

notes: No central system in the Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. Institution closing dates were not collected on this pass.
